laser_measure_rack.name: Laser Measure Rack
laser_measure_rack.description: Ten laser measures mounted in one rail, sweeping a cone in lockstep: ten dead-parallel beams that rotate as one solid sheet of light. The pattern is read on whatever the beams land on, never on the rack. phase_step_deg breaks the lockstep, and which way that cuts depends on the motion — under yaw or pitch an offset of 360/count stands one whole travelling wave on the rack and 0 collapses it to a bar, while under orbit (the default) 0 is the figure and any offset only decorrelates ten copies of it. Five motions: orbit puts yaw and pitch in quadrature so each beam traces a cone, yaw sweeps sideways, pitch up and down, rise lifts the instruments in place without turning them, lissajous crosses two rates so each beam draws a figure.
